data_point: Operates as a startup selling nationally
run_when: Always, for companies still in the running.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company operates as a startup rather than a small business: it sells a scalable software or technology product to customers beyond its own metro area, where revenue grows independently of headcount.
prompt.definition: This is the single most important discriminator on the profile. It cannot be true together with 'Local professional services firm'.
yes_when: A software or tech product sold to customers anywhere (self-serve sign up, national or global customers)
no_when: The company sells its own billed labour into one metro area: agency, consultancy, contractor, clinic, single-location operation
unknown_when: Not enough text to tell what or where it sells
watch_out_for: Don't judge by how polished the site is
A service business with national clients and no scalable product is NOT this signal

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Resend: email API for developers. Start for free. Plans from $20/mo. Trusted by teams worldwide.

output.evidence_quote: email API for developers. Start for free.
output.reason: A self-serve software product sold to developers anywhere.
